speaker: god
text: These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the LORD.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Consider carefully your ways.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have planted much but harvested little. You eat but never have enough. You drink but never have your fill. You put on clothes but never get warm. You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Consider carefully your ways.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You expected much, but behold, it amounted to little. And what you brought home, I blew away. Why? declares the LORD of Hosts. Because My house still lies in ruins, while each of you is busy with his own house.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, on account of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth has withheld its crops.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have summoned a drought on the fields and on the mountains, on the grain, new wine, and oil, and on whatever the ground yields, on man and beast, and on all the labor of your hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am with you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and also to the remnant of the people. Ask them,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, declares the LORD. Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And be strong, all you people of the land, declares the LORD. Work! For I am with you, declares the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt. And My Spirit remains among you; do not be afraid.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Once more, in a little while, I will shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will shake all the nations, and they will come with all their treasures, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, declares the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former, says the LORD of Hosts. And in this place I will provide peace, declares the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Ask the priests for a ruling.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If a man carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and it touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any other food, does that item become holy?’
name: The LORD

speaker: priests
text: No,
name: The priests

speaker: haggai
text: If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these, does it become defiled?
name: Haggai

speaker: priests
text: Yes, it becomes defiled,
name: The priests

speaker: haggai
text: So it is with this people and this nation before Me, declares the LORD, and so it is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.
name: Haggai

speaker: haggai
text: Now consider carefully from this day forward: Before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the LORD,
name: Haggai

speaker: haggai
text: from that time, when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain, there were but ten. When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths, there were but twenty.
name: Haggai

speaker: haggai
text: I struck you—all the work of your hands—with blight, mildew, and hail, but you did not turn to Me, declares the LORD.
name: Haggai

speaker: haggai
text: Consider carefully from this day forward—from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the day the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid—consider carefully:
name: Haggai

speaker: haggai
text: Is there still seed in the barn? The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit. But from this day on, I will bless you.
name: Haggai

speaker: god
text: Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am about to shake the heavens and the earth:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will overturn royal thrones and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overturn chariots and their riders; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will take you, My servant, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, declares the LORD, and I will make you like My signet ring, for I have chosen you, declares the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD
